Calculate I_trigger

Source: R/dls_functions.R
calc_Itrigger.Rd

Calculates I_trigger from I_loss (i.e. I_trigger = I_loss*1.4)

Usage

calc_Itrigger(Iloss, factor = 1.4)

Arguments

Iloss

Iloss

factor

I_trigger / I_loss (1.4 in ICES 2025)

Value

I_trigger

See also

calc_iloss() and ref_points_iloss() for I_loss.
